Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The repair work shall be carried out at the Buyer's premises only. the successful bidder shall arrange all necessary tools, equipment, skilled manpower and consumables required for execution of the work at the buyers location. 3. Bidders are advised to inspect the vehicle and assess the scope of repair work at the buyers premises. 3. The bidder shall quote a lump-sum rate inclusive of all labour charges, consumables, taxes and all incid ental expenses required for satisfactory completion of the work. 4. Only genuine OEM spare parts or equivalent approved quality spare parts shall be used. 5. Payment shall be released after satisfactory completion of the repair work and acceptance by the buyer. 6. The successful bidder shall ensure that all personnel deployed for repair work comply with the security a nd entry procedures of the buyers establishment. .
